status_summary: An Attorney General memorandum dated 2025-02-05 directed DOJ to prioritize the elimination of cartels and transnational criminal organizations. It suspended certain internal approval requirements for racketeering charges against them, with 24-hour notice to the Criminal Division, for an initial 90 days that could be renewed or made permanent, and it expanded two task forces, JTF Vulcan and JTF Alpha. A separate 2025-02-05 charging memorandum directed prosecutors to charge the most serious readily provable offense. The sources reviewed do not show a policy of prosecuting simple possession of distributable quantities.

timeline.event: An executive order directed the designation of certain cartels and other organizations as foreign terrorist organizations and specially designated global terrorists.

The Attorney General issued a memorandum on the total elimination of cartels and transnational criminal organizations, suspending approval requirements for racketeering charges for 90 days (renewable) and expanding JTF Vulcan to include Tren de Aragua.
